name: targetTable
label: Target table
description: Table name of the record against which Email Client

name: targetRecord
label: Target record
description: Record sysId against which Email Client needs to be launched

name: responseObj
label: Response Details Object
description: The object containing the response operation to be performed.

name: draftRecordId
label: Draft Record Id
description: SysId of the record inside sys_email_draft table to be displayed. Only used if newRecord is false.

name: sendDraft
label: Send draft
description: Flag to be set to initiate a send operation.

name: emailTemplate
label: Email template
description: Object containing email template to apply
